camel_example: aliyun dts ShieldPrecheck --region cn-hangzhou --PrecheckItems CHECK_SAME_OBJ --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsi76118o3w920000
description_en: Skips the precheck for a legacy data migration or synchronization task
kebab_example: aliyun dts shield-precheck --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-instance-id dtsi76118o3w920000 --precheck-items CHECK_SAME_OBJ --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ShieldPrecheck

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration or synchronization instance. You can call the DescribeMigrationJobs or DescribeSynchronizationJobs operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移或同步实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeMigrationJobs、DescribeSynchronizationJobs接口查询
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The precheck items to skip. Separate multiple items with commas (,). Valid values:

CHECK_SAME_OBJ: checks whether objects with the same name exist.
CHECK_SAME_USER: checks whether accounts with different names exist.
CHECK_SRC: checks the source database version.
CHECK_TOPOLOGY: checks the topology version.
For the topology versions supported by DTS, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124115.html.
CHECK_SERVER_ID: checks the server_id of the source database
parameters.help_zh:
预检查项，取值如下，多个预检查项以英文逗号（,）分隔。

CHECK_SAME_OBJ：同名对象存在性检查。
CHECK_SAME_USER：不同名账号存在性检查。
CHECK_SRC：源库版本检查。
CHECK_TOPOLOGY：拓扑版本检查。
目前DTS支持的拓扑版本，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/124115.html。
CHECK_SERVER_ID：源库server_id检查
parameters.name: precheck_items
